verses.commentary: Woe to those who plan iniquity, plot evil on their beds. At dawn they execute because they have power. Premeditated sin. Nights spent scheming, mornings spent acting. Power enables evil.

They covet fields and seize them, houses and take them. Defraud people of homes, rob inheritance. Systematic dispossession. Land concentration destroys small farmers. Economic violence against covenant community.
Therefore the Lord plans disaster against this people. You cannot save yourselves. No more proud walking. Time of calamity. God's plan answers human planning. What they plotted, God reverses.

That day people will ridicule you, taunt with mournful song: We are utterly ruined! Our possession divided! He takes from me, assigns our fields to traitors. The oppressors become the oppressed. Their words return as mockery.
No one in the Lord's assembly to divide land by lot. The dispossessors lose their place in land distribution. Covenant membership forfeited. Those who took cannot participate when God redistributes.
Do not prophesy, their prophets say. Do not prophesy these things; disgrace will not overtake us. False prophets silence true ones. The message rejected because consequences denied.
Should it be said: Does the Lord become impatient? Does he do such things? Do not my words do good to the upright? Divine self defense. God's words bless the obedient. Patience has limits.
Lately my people have risen up like an enemy. You strip robes from passersby who think themselves safe. Fellow Israelites attacking fellow Israelites. Internal betrayal. Trust violated.
You drive women from pleasant homes, take away my blessing from their children forever. Widows and orphans dispossessed. The vulnerable expelled. Generational harm from present injustice.
Get up, go away! This is not your resting place. It is defiled, ruined beyond remedy. The land vomits out inhabitants. Pollution requires evacuation. No restoration possible.

If a liar and deceiver comes saying: I will prophesy plenty of wine and beer, that would be just the prophet for this people! Sarcasm stings. They want prophets who promise pleasure. Deception welcomed when it comforts.

I will surely gather all of you, Jacob. I will bring together Israel's remnant like sheep in a pen, like a flock in pasture. The place will throng with people. Sudden shift to hope. Judgment leads to regathering.

The One who breaks open goes before them. They break through the gate and go out. Their King passes before them, the Lord at their head. Divine breaker leads the exodus. Imprisonment broken. The King marches at the front of his people.
